concept: Describe what you're hoping for (business, harvest, protection, safe travel), and AI matches it to a real Inari shrine dedication style, from Fushimi Inari's senbon torii to a small neighborhood inari-sha, explaining the symbolism of the kitsune fox messengers and correct offering and prayer etiquette.

Describe a mood or moment you want turned into a short story, and AI writes an original rakugo-style comic tale using the real classical structure (makura intro, hon-banashi, ochi punchline), explaining the tradition's single-performer, no-props storytelling style with a note on an iconic real piece like Manju Kowai.

Describe what you want to know about an upcoming sumo tournament (a wrestler, a technique, a rank), and AI explains it using the real basho structure, the six-tournament annual calendar, and genuine kimarite winning techniques, distinct from an existing app's sumo-ring trivia by focusing on the tournament and ranking system itself.
